current_boundary.rollback_gap: A valid historical repository-local HEAD.json can replace the current HEAD without violating its self-hash.

detects: repository-local rollback to an older valid HEAD after a newer HEAD was externally anchored
missing or divergent external anchor sequence entries
repository-local HEAD bytes that disagree with the latest external anchor
does_not_claim: protection from compromise of the external anchor writer and retention administrator together
source authorization or canonical PIT provenance
scheduler, Engine-0, execution, paper, live, or trading parity

hash_recipe.json_rules: recursive plain JSON; object keys sorted; separators comma and colon with no spaces; ensure_ascii=true; allow_nan=false
hash_recipe.exact_record_hash_rule: SHA-256 over canonical_json(full_record_with_semantic_hash).encode(UTF-8) followed by one LF

anchor_record_contract.scope: one approved anchor-genesis cutover followed by every successful segmented HEAD.json append, zero-event manifest, and rotation transition before another HEAD transition or any canonical consumption
anchor_record_contract.canonical_encoding: v2_canonical_json_sha256_v1 full-record bytes with exactly one LF termination
identity_rules: head_exact_sha256 hashes the exact committed HEAD.json bytes, including the LF terminator
head_hash and all copied HEAD identities must equal the validated local HEAD
anchor_sequence starts at 1 and increases by exactly one
previous_anchor_record_sha256 is null only for the approved sequence-1 anchor genesis and otherwise binds the preceding immutable anchor
environment, store_id, and ledger_stream_id prevent cross-environment or cross-root replay
previous_head_hash is null only for the approved anchor genesis and otherwise equals the preceding anchor head_hash
anchor_record_sha256 uses v2_canonical_json_sha256_v1 semantic_hash_rule over the anchor payload without anchor_record_sha256

external_receipt_contract.provider_receipt_sha256_rule: SHA-256 over the exact raw provider response bytes preserved at provider_receipt_raw_locator; no decoding, normalization, LF insertion, or self field is involved
external_receipt_contract.anchor_object_exact_sha256_rule: v2_canonical_json_sha256_v1 exact_record_hash_rule over the full immutable anchor record
external_receipt_contract.provider_signature: required only when the selected target contract uses signed receipts

target_requirements.requirement: The anchor namespace and retention control are outside the repository and local ledger host boundary.
The runtime writer can create a new record but cannot overwrite, delete, shorten retention, or alter an existing record.
Retention is locked for at least the full lifetime of every canonical claim that depends on the anchor.
A reader can strongly and deterministically discover the latest committed sequence and read it back immediately after append.
Exact retry returns the same immutable record; the same sequence or object identity with different bytes fails.
The target enforces a single monotonic stream through an ordered offset or atomic predecessor compare-and-append; WORM storage without a trustworthy monotonic latest record is insufficient.
The target returns an externally generated immutable object identity, commit time, and content identity that can be audited.
Append, read, and retention-administration IAM principal IDs are distinct least-privilege non-secret identity references with named owners.

target_options.condition: Use only with locked retention, create-only writer credentials, strong enumeration/read-after-write, a separate administrative boundary, and a machine-proved monotonic latest protocol.
Use only if the service enforces predecessor/sequence ordering, immutable retention, idempotent append, and strongly consistent latest reads.
Requires a separate host/account, documented backup and retention operations, independent ownership, and the same acceptance tests as a managed target.

rejected_substitutes: the same Git repository or a Git remote alone
the same host filesystem or a mutable database row
ordinary object versioning without locked retention and restricted delete permissions
a locally signed file when the signing key is available to the ledger writer
publication_protocol: Before cutover, freeze one immutable selected contract with authorization, target, retention, principals, requested window, and the existing research-only HEAD exact identity; this is not ledger bootstrap and grants no retroactive eligibility.
Publish sequence-1 transition_kind=anchor_genesis bound to that pre-cutover selected-contract hash.
Validate and publish immutable local records, then atomically publish HEAD.json under the existing writer lock.
Before external append, validate the transition-specific successor proof against the latest verified external anchor; sequence continuity alone is insufficient.
Before another HEAD transition, atomically compare-and-append the exact HEAD identity to the selected external stream with the next sequence and predecessor anchor hash.
Read the external record back through the read principal and verify its bytes, selected-contract identity, retention receipt, sequence, predecessor, successor proof, and copied HEAD identities.

After sequence-1 read-back, publish a separate immutable anchor-genesis activation receipt that binds the selected contract, external receipt, generated clocks, absent canonical-forward start, and default-off boundary.
Treat the local head as anchored only after read-back verification; a lost acknowledgement is resolved by exact idempotent retry.
If anchoring fails after local HEAD publication, keep the store research-only and block the next HEAD transition until the current head is anchored or the root is quarantined.

anchor_genesis: anchor_sequence is 1 and both predecessor hashes are null
environment, store_id, ledger_stream_id, head_exact_sha256, and head_hash equal the approved cutover contract
a post-cutover activation receipt binds the pre-cutover selected contract and sequence-1 external receipt
activation-receipt cutover_verified_at is no earlier than both the sequence-1 service commit and independent read-back verification
activation-receipt anchor_gate_eligibility_started_at is no earlier than cutover_verified_at and cannot upgrade evidence created before it
activation-receipt canonical_forward_eligibility_started_at remains null until a separate canonical review
append: the new checkpoint_hash equals the preceding anchor checkpoint_hash and the validated new tail chain strictly extends the preceding anchored tail
manifest_count increases by exactly one, event_count increases, and the new tip manifest previous id/hash equals the preceding anchor tip
the new local predecessor state used to build the segment exactly equals the preceding external anchor HEAD identity
zero_event_manifest: the new checkpoint_hash equals the preceding anchor checkpoint_hash and the validated new tail chain strictly extends the preceding anchored tail
manifest_count increases by exactly one, event_count remains unchanged, and the new tip manifest previous id/hash equals the preceding anchor tip
the new local predecessor state used to build the zero-event segment exactly equals the preceding external anchor HEAD identity
rotation: the new compact checkpoint compacted_from_head.head_hash equals previous_head_hash
event_count, manifest_count, and tip manifest id/hash equal the preceding anchor while checkpoint/head exact identities change and tail_segment_hash is null
successor_validation.reset_policy: No reset or lineage fork is allowed inside a stream. A new genesis requires a separately approved ledger_stream_id and cutover contract.

canonical_read_protocol: Strictly validate the local segmented store and exact HEAD.json bytes.
Query the external target directly; a repository-local cache or receipt cannot substitute for this query.
Validate the contiguous external sequence and latest anchor record identity; one-behind, one-ahead, or ambiguous latest state all fail closed.
Require the latest external head_exact_sha256 and copied HEAD fields to equal the current local HEAD.

Require the external receipt to bind the approved pre-cutover selected contract and target, require the activation receipt for sequence 1, and require locked retention to cover the full canonical claim lifetime.
Fail closed on target outage, missing sequence, divergent record, invalid successor, local rollback, expired retention, wrong target contract, or identity mismatch.

acceptance_tests.expected: same identity and same bytes is idempotent; different bytes at the same identity fail
writer cannot overwrite, delete, shorten retention, or change retention policy
the independent approved read principal returns the appended record as the unique latest sequence and freezes raw read evidence plus the exact anchor-object hash
retry after a committed append with a lost response returns the same immutable identity
replacing local HEAD with an older valid HEAD blocks canonical consumption against the newer external anchor
a missing, repeated, or divergent predecessor sequence fails closed
canonical reads and subsequent HEAD transitions fail closed; trade_enabled remains false
selected-contract writer, reader, and retention-admin principal IDs are distinct; reader cannot append, writer cannot administer retention, and runtime principals cannot delete
a compact rotation with unchanged manifest/event counts still creates a new sequence bound to the new exact HEAD
an otherwise valid anchor from a different environment, store, or ledger stream fails closed
a remote latest record behind or ahead of the validated local HEAD is quarantined rather than auto-adopted
rolling back to an older valid HEAD and then appending a new valid local branch fails successor validation against the latest external anchor

sequence 1 binds the immutable pre-cutover selected contract; a separate activation receipt binds service commit, independently evidenced exact read-back, and ordered verified/anchor-gate times while canonical forward start remains null
a receipt from an unapproved target contract or weaker/expired retention policy fails closed

selected_contract_policy.selected_contract_artifact_policy: create a new content-addressed append-only artifact after explicit authorization and before sequence-1 external append
selected_contract_policy.selected_contract_hash_rule: v2_canonical_json_sha256_v1 semantic_hash_rule over the selected contract without anchor_contract_sha256

activation_receipt_contract.artifact_policy: create a separate content-addressed append-only artifact only after sequence-1 external commit and independent read-back
time_rules: cutover_verified_at is no earlier than sequence_one_service_committed_at and sequence_one_readback_verified_at
sequence_one_readback_verified_at is no earlier than sequence_one_service_committed_at
anchor_gate_eligibility_started_at is no earlier than cutover_verified_at
canonical_forward_eligibility_started_at is null until a separate canonical review
readback_rules: reader_principal_id equals the approved selected-contract read principal and differs from writer_principal_id
readback_provider_target_id and readback_immutable_locator equal the approved target and sequence-1 immutable object
readback_raw_sha256 hashes the exact preserved provider read response bytes at readback_raw_locator
independent_readback_evidence_sha256 binds the reader, target, locator, raw response identity, exact anchor object identity, and verified time
boundary_rules: external_append_anchor_status may become verified only for the exact selected stream and sequence-1 identities
trade_enabled remains false and no existing evidence is retroactively upgraded
activation_receipt_contract.hash_rule: v2_canonical_json_sha256_v1 semantic_hash_rule over the activation receipt without activation_receipt_sha256

next_action: After the user selects and authorizes the target, create a new selected-contract artifact bound to this immutable packet; do not edit this decision packet in place.
